senses.gloss: इत्थम् [ittham], ind. Thus, so, in this manner; इत्थं रतेः किमपि भूतमदृश्यरूपम् Ku.4.45; इत्थंगते under these circumstances, such being the case; इत्थंगते किमस्माभिः करणीयम् Ś.4; R.9.81. -Comp. -कारम् ind. in this manner. -भूत a.
so circumstanced, being in this state, being thus; ˚आख्याने P.I.4.9; Me.96; Ku.6.26; Ś.3.5; कथ- मित्थंभूता M.5, K.146.
true or faithful (as a story).-भावः being thus endowed, having these qualities.-विध a.
इत्थशालः [itthaśālḥ], N. of the third Yoga in Astronomy (Arabic origin).
In this manner, thus; क इत्थावेद यत्र सः Kaṭh.1.2.24.
A particle of affirmation used to lay stress on a following word, indeed.
Truly, really. ˚धी a. performing such or true works.
इत्थात् [itthāt], ind. Thus, in this way.
